teaser.en: Crush a leaf and sniff: the smell is so sharp that its name says it 'smacks the brain'.
teaser.sw: Finyanga jani na unuse: harufu yake ni kali mno kiasi kwamba jina lake linasema 'hupiga ubongo'.

summary.en: Mkota wongo is a coastal forest shrub whose crushed leaves give off a strong, pungent smell. Its name says the smell 'smacks the brain'.
summary.sw: Mkota wongo ni kichaka cha misitu ya pwani ambacho majani yake yakifinywa hutoa harufu kali inayochoma puani. Jina lake linasema kwamba harufu hiyo 'hupiga ubongo'.

about.en:
*Mkota wongo* is a shrub or small tree of the coastal forest. Its most distinctive feature is the leaves, which give off a strong, pungent smell when they are crushed and sniffed. Pakia's informants identified it by the look and the smell of the leaves.

*Grevea* is a small genus found only in eastern Africa and Madagascar. Male and female flowers grow on separate plants.
about.sw:
*Mkota wongo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa misitu ya pwani. Sifa yake iliyo wazi zaidi ni majani, ambayo hutoa harufu kali inayochoma puani yanapofinywa na kunuswa. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa sura na harufu ya majani.

*Grevea* ni jenasi ndogo inayopatikana tu mashariki mwa Afrika na Madagaska. Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye mimea tofauti.

where.en: It is a plant of the East African coastal forests and thickets, including those of the south Kenya coast.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa misitu na vichaka vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, ikiwemo ile ya pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya.

culture.en: Smell is one of the senses Digo speakers use to identify plants, and this name records it directly. Pakia lists it with *chinuka*, the 'smelly' plants, as examples of plant names based on smell.
culture.sw: Harufu ni mojawapo ya hisi ambazo wasemaji wa Kidigo huzitumia kutambua mimea, na jina hili linairekodi moja kwa moja. Pakia analiorodhesha pamoja na *chinuka*, mimea 'inayonuka', kama mifano ya majina ya mimea yanayotokana na harufu.

names.en: *Mkota wongo* means 'smacking the brain': the smell of the leaves is said to hit (*kota*) the brain (*wongo*). In the main text Pakia glosses it as 'stimulating the brain'. No other language shares the name, and there is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mkota wongo* maana yake ni 'kupiga ubongo': harufu ya majani husemekana kuupiga (*kota*) ubongo (*wongo*). Katika matini kuu Pakia analieleza kuwa 'kuchangamsha ubongo'. Hakuna lugha nyingine inayoshiriki jina hili, na hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili katika vyanzo.

reason.en: Another plant name built on wongo, 'brain'
reason.sw: Jina jingine la mmea lililojengwa juu ya wongo, 'ubongo'
Pia umepewa jina kutokana na harufu yake

reason.en: Another plant known by its aromatic leaves
reason.sw: Mrihani, mmea mwingine unaojulikana kwa majani yake yenye harufu nzuri
